name: exectrunc
description: A TRUNCATED IMAGE IS REFUSED WITH ITS ERRNO, NOT ZERO (apple/fgx#520).  The fixture is /bin/true's first 400 bytes: the header and segment table are whole, segment 0 is cut short, so the loader's segment read hits end of file and `_LoadOneSegment` answers EIO.  Before the fix, code that ran after every segment load clobbered the low byte of that errno with an 8-bit flag test, so execve failed with errno 0 and ldd printed `Undefined error: 0'.  ldd execs the image and perror()s the failure (SunOS ldd's own shape, bin/ldd.c).  Expect `Input/output error'; `Undefined error: 0' is the old bug's signature.
